Bullshit can only remain if we continue to put up with it, for we "put it up", give it shelter, in our acceptance of it. We put it up, and most significantly are thus put down and held down by it. To get over is not a matter of "putting it down", as we do with such futility over a pint or two, putting the world to rights in the most ironically wrong fashion; rather, we simply have to stop putting-up with it, to retract the complicity of our cowardice. To stop putting up with bullshit, the bully attendant to Man's experience of the school of life, we have to stand up to it. First we do this in ourselves; the bully has long since gotten under our skin.
